sn22.159:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || || upasaṅkamitvā || pa || Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 3
sn22.159:1.3: Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yam aham Bhagavato dhammam sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti || || 4
sn22.159:2.2: Rūpaṃ niccam vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.159:2.4: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.159:2.6: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu tam anupassituṃ
sn22.159:2.7: Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attā ti || ||
sn22.159:2.14: Yam panāniccam dukkhaṃ vāti-sukhaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.159:2.16: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ || kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ
sn22.159:2.17: Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti || || 9
sn22.159:2.18: Tasmā ti hānanda yaṃ kiñci rūpam atītānāgatapaccuppannam || || 10
sn22.159:3.1: Ajjhattikam Etam mama Eso me attā No ca me siyā ||
